messages:
Priya Nair: Quick intake — flagging starlit-9b-q4 for onboarding. Goal: host + dedicated paths. Initial perf looks good but QA found a small regression on refusal phrasing. Need prioritized checklist and safe rollout plan.
Alex Chen: Can you drop the eval links and perf numbers? CPU/GPU p99, token/s, and a small sample of the failing prompts would help.
Priya Nair: Uploaded results: https://internal-ml/runs/2026-03-starlit9b. Key notes: base latency p95=110ms on A100, p99=220ms; quant q4_k_m reduces cost ~2.1x but increases p99 by ~30ms. Quality: ROUGE/QA accuracy ~on-par, but refusal tone shifts on 6/120 seed prompts.
Jordan Lee: Which quant path did you try? q4_k_m? int4? Any kernel issues in the runtime?
Alex Chen: We ran q4_k_m and int8-dp in the benchmark. q4_k_m had best cost/latency tradeoff; int4 unstable for some attention patterns (see logs).
Samir Gupta: For rollout gating let's set explicit smoke thresholds: latency p95 < 150ms hosted, p99 < 280ms; generation correctness top metrics delta < 1.5% vs baseline on eval set; refusal/regressions flagged if >3 failing prompts in curated safety set. If any fail, immediate rollback.
Elena Morales: I can own canary. Proposal: 2% traffic -> 10% -> 30% with 60m soak at each step. KV cache warmup: prefill with the top 200 prefixes from logs before going 10%. Also need automated perf-replay for peak sequence lengths.
Priya Nair: Nice. Also need plan for dedicated customers: a) dedicated pool build/test on private infra, b) private deployment checklist (KMS/HSM keys validated, network egress rules), c) fallback routes to starlit-7b-lt if regressions hit.
Alex Chen: I'll assemble the eval set and add the failing prompts. Will run a focused human eval for refusal tone with 150 samples. ETA EOD Friday.
Samir Gupta: Add monitoring alerts:
```
ALERT Starlit_High_P99
  IF latency_p99{model=\"starlit-9b-q4\"} > 300
  FOR 5m
  LABELS { severity = \"page\" }
```
Also add a quality alert: if rolling_quality_delta > 1.5% for 30m.
Jordan Lee: Quick smoke commands for devs:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" \
  -d '{"model":"starlit-9b-q4","prompt":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":64}'
```
Run with --stream for real latency.
Elena Morales: I will start canary Monday 09:00 PT. Traffic plan: 2% initial, monitor for 30m, then 10% with KV prefill, then 30% if green. Canary owner steps: smoke tests, chaos-sim (occlusion of GPU) for 15m, rollout dashboard pinned.
Priya Nair: Rollback criteria recap: any of the following -> pause and rollback to starlit-7b-lt: 1) p99 > 300ms sustained 5m; 2) quality delta > 2% on core eval; 3) safety/regression > 3 seeds flagged by human eval.
Alex Chen: Noted. Also tagging support & sales: @support-team @acct-owners for customers on dedicated pools.
Elena Morales: deploy-bot, kick the canary when ready.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: starlit-9b-q4 -> 2% traffic at 2026-03-23T16:00:00Z. Status: queued.
Samir Gupta: I'll run overnight quant sweep comparing q4_k_m / q5_0 / int8-dp for lat/quality curve and post results.
Priya Nair: Thanks — action items: Elena owns canary, Alex eval set + human eval, Samir quant sweep, Jordan runtime perf checks, Priya will coordinate dedicated/private checklist and customer comms. Update thread with final canary start and first soak results. :thumbsup:
